basics.name: Diego Arbiz Jr.
basics.label: AI Systems Developer
basics.summary: AI Systems Developer and automation architect focused on building AI-powered applications and scalable workflow infrastructure. 8+ years across digital systems, SaaS environments, and business automation, specialising in turning AI from prompt experimentation into structured, production-ready systems. Designs LLM-powered applications on Claude and API-based platforms, architecting the intelligent workflows, backend logic, and automation that connect AI models with CRMs, marketing platforms, and operational tools. Co-runs Scale With System with his spouse Kat, helping agencies and digital businesses scale through automation, CRM strategy, and AI-enhanced funnel infrastructure.

projects.name: Sales Coach AI — AI pipeline layer
projects.description: Real-time sales coaching over live calls. Built by a team of six; I own the AI layer — coaching pipelines and prompt architecture in packages/ai — and wrote the cue-evaluation harness that gates coaching output against a scripted quality bar. 80 of 285 commits (Apr–Aug 2026), the largest single share.
